text_block_list.text:
Inari One and the others received a request to appear in a student's indie film.
Even with unfamiliar acting, they gave it their serious best—

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: —Scene 10, action!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's far enough, Lord Ma-ken! I cannot forgive
your atrocious deeds!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You broke through my Dark Feng Shui Barrier?!
What a stubborn pest...
Are you not terrified of Lord Ma-ken?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...I am scared.
Even so—I will stop him! Even if it costs my life!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Someone of your caliber? Don't make me laugh.
I am the successor of the Da-A-To God Fist, Lord Ma-ken!
None can obstruct my path of conquest!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: —Cut!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Great work, everyone!
Inari-san, you had such incredible presence.
Don't you think you'd make a great actor?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Cut it out, I was an amateur through and through.
Well, since I agreed to take the role,
I just gave it everything I got.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oho, even though you looked so dissatisfied when you heard you were playing the villain,
you're totally fired up now!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well yeah, it's enterin' a contest, right?
I can't go dragging everyone down
with some half-assed acting.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Just what I'd expect from Inari-san!
Rickey, don't let her beat you, do your best too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
An evil sorceress aiding Lord Ma-ken with the power of Feng Shui!
It's such a perfect role, I'm having a total blast♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright. —Oh, by the way.
I brought some snacks for everyone,
a recommended specialty treat from Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, much obliged.
Let's call Falco over and take a breather together!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
—About the confrontation scene coming up,
when you face Lord Ma-ken,
I want you to avert your eyes for just a moment.

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist used to be Lord Ma-ken's
rival and closest friend.
...Until he avoided conflict and vanished.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Is that out of kindness? Or because of weakness?

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Both. In pure skill, the protagonist is slightly superior.
However, being unable to fight his friend seriously
could also be called weakness.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
He never wants to fight, yet he's the only one who can stop him.
Is there really no other way than trading blows... That's the protagonist's inner conflict...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ............Two people whose paths diverged, huh...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, Lord Ma-ken...!
I will definitely stop you...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Futile. What can someone who fled from destiny possibly hope to accomplish!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...I will not run anymore.
Because I am your—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Silence! This is the end for youuuu!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry for stoppin' the scene...
But, but y'know...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Just imaginin' two close friends havin' to turn against each other...
it makes my chest ache so much...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
'Cause if I put myself in those shoes...
Quittin' on honein' our skills together and partin' ways like that?
I just...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
They say us Edokko are quick to brawl.
But y'know, fightin' is supposed to be
something folks do to understand each other!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Clenchin' my fist just to cut ties like this...
even if it's just actin' out a role...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Inari-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sorry 'bout that, got a bit too caught up in it.
Director, let me have another go.
This time I'll make sure to—

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: No, that's fine. Cut right here.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
C-Come on, gimme a chance!
Next time I'll properly devote myself to bein' a cold-hearted villain—

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: There's no need for that. Your tears added so much depth to the character of the Demon Fist King!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: So we're going to change the script! We'll reschedule the shoot for another day. Hehe, this is going to be a masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Seems like things blew up into somethin' crazy, but was that really okay?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Of course it is!
The tragic ending from before was nice, but a happy ending is way better anyway!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Just thinking about their paths crossing once again makes Falco wanna... *sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whoa, hey, cut it out! What if you make me cry too?! Sheesh, getting all sentimental just isn't my style.
